name: ggml-speech
description: Speech-stack ggml flavour consumed by speech-cpp. 2026-10-20: WebGPU backend (webgpu feature on Google Dawn) made usable: loader probes the webgpu module, high-performance adapter, Dawn's Null adapter refused, unaligned tensor I/O and large dispatch grids fixed (qvac-ext-ggml#127, merge a6122941).

metal-fuse-mv-bias.description: Compile in the Q-variant mul_mv + ADD(bias) [+ ADD(residual)] fusion in ggml-metal. Off by default: empirically produces zero tokens on parakeet's EOU q8_0 joint network. Opt in only after Metal A/B-validating your model against the fused path.

webgpu.description: Enable the WebGPU GPU backend (ggml-webgpu on Google Dawn, driven natively through webgpu.h; no browser involved). Opt-in on every platform: Dawn targets Vulkan on Linux/Windows/Android and Metal on Apple. Dawn comes from this registry's dawn port (the official port pinned at a version the speech-branch backend compiles against, with Linux defaults trimmed to Vulkan); a consumer must import vulkan-headers, vulkan-utility-libraries and vcpkg-get-python-packages from microsoft/vcpkg in its vcpkg-configuration.json.
